description: Ground truth for criteria that need agent judgement. Each case lists only the criteria its page was built to settle; other criteria are not scored. Add a case by adding an HTML file under cases/ and an entry here. The v2 cases (cases/v2) come in pairs: a page with defects (_1) and its fixed twin (_2); the owner signed off their answers on 2026-10-18.
